about_the_game:
🪦Shoulder the coffin, afterlife awaits!


Grave Bros is a laughter-filled parkour adventure. As two players carry a coffin together, sometimes you'll need to proceed in unison, and other times you'll have to temporarily split up to clear the path. Knowing when to share the load and when to separate and reunite is crucial.

Every step is a challenge, every jump a risk, and every fall... pure comedy. Stay balanced, think fast, and — if possible — try not to drop Grandma along the way.

👬 Teamwork and Solo Moments Hand in Hand

The game's standout feature is the ability to switch between carrying the coffin together and progressing individually. Some obstacles require synchronized movement, while others necessitate one player leaving the coffin behind to press a button or open a path. Then, reunite, share the load, and continue your journey.

Coordination, trust, and lots of laughter are essential parts of this adventure.

🎯 Key Features

  • Two-player cooperative gameplay with local or online co-op support

  • Parkour enriched with the coffin-dropping mechanic

  • Humorous and surprise-filled obstacles

  • Colorful, witty, and energetic visual style

  • Easy to learn, endlessly replayable levels

Whether you're stumbling or soaring through the air, Grave Bros offers a journey full of friendship, cooperation, and guaranteed laughter.

Are you ready? Because you can only reach this grave together.

short_description: Grave Bros is a fun and chaotic co-op parkour game where two players carry a coffin. Split up or stick together to overcome obstacles and reach the grave. Timing, communication, and lots of laughs are the key to success!
supported_languages: English, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Turkish
